title: Space Over Statistic, Retraining Over Ranking: Auditing Training Labels Under Label-Only Backdoors
abstract: arXiv:2610.13051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Some backdoor attacks never touch an image. FLIP only changes labels: on CIFAR-10, flipping 3% of them makes a ResNet-32 send 99.7% of triggered source-class images to the attacker's class. The usual defenses look for the poison inside a model trained on those same labels. So when they struggle, is the problem the test they run, or the space they run it in?   We answer with a controlled swap: we keep the test, the labels and the metric fixed, change only the feature space, and judge each defense by retraining the victim on what it keeps. The space decides. On dog$\to$cat the same nearest-neighbor check scores AUROC 0.546 on the poisoned model's features, 0.967 on frozen DINOv2 features that never saw a label, and 0.995 on the same network trained on clean labels, an oracle control rather than a defense. We reproduce SPECTRE, the defense FLIP's authors recommend, to 90.94 / 0.97 against its published 91.47 / 1.7, then price it: on truck

translated_title: 空间重于统计，重训练重于排序：仅标签后门攻击下的训练标签审计
translated_abstract: 有些后门攻击从不触碰图像本身。FLIP只修改标签：在CIFAR-10上，仅需翻转3%的标签，就能让一个ResNet-32把99.7%携带触发器的源类图像归入攻击者指定的类别。常规防御手段是在用这些（被污染的）标签训练出的模型内部寻找投毒数据。那么，当这些防御失效时，问题究竟出在它们运行的检测方法上，还是它们所处的特征空间？我们通过一项受控交换实验来回答：固定检测方法、标签与评价指标，仅更换特征空间，并通过让受害模型在其保留的数据上重新训练来评判每种防御的优劣。结果证明，特征空间起决定性作用：在dog→cat（狗→猫）攻击上，同一个最近邻检测在投毒模型自身特征上的AUROC仅为0.546，在从未见过任何标签的冻结DINOv2特征上为0.967，而在用干净标签训练的同一网络的特征上达到0.995——后者是预言机式的对照，而非防御方法。我们以90.94/0.97的指标复现了FLIP作者推荐的防御SPECTRE（对比其发表的91.47/1.7），随后对其代价进行衡量：在truck（卡车）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过受控实验证明，防御仅标签后门攻击（如FLIP）的成败关键在于特征空间而非检测方法本身——同一个最近邻检测在冻结的DINOv2自监督特征上AUROC达0.967，而在投毒模型自身特征上仅0.546，并且应以重训练后的效果而非样本排序结果来评判防御方法。
en_tdlr: Through controlled experiments, this study shows that the success of defenses against label-only backdoors like FLIP hinges on the feature space rather than the test itself—the same nearest-neighbor check achieves AUROC 0.967 on frozen DINOv2 features but only 0.546 on the poisoned model's features, and defenses should be judged by retraining outcomes rather than sample rankings.
